comment: The panel prints EQUALIZER; the module browser calls it C1-EQ. Both outer bands default to Cut (B1_MODE_PARAM and B4_MODE_PARAM default 2), and the mode-change branch fires on the first process() because lastB1Mode starts at -1, so a freshly added module has its LF frequency written to 20Hz and its HF frequency to 20kHz and both those GAIN knobs pinned at 0dB by setValue every sample (src/C1EQ.cpp:1230-1233, 1556-1586). Turning either GAIN knob while C is chosen does nothing, and the knob springs back. The param values run 0 Shelf, 1 Bell, 2 Cut, and are inverted again inside updateBandCoefficients as 2 - rawMode; the C, B, S lamps are wired to match the panel. LF and HF Q are hardcoded at 0.8 and 1.0 (src/C1EQ.cpp:1400-1404) and at 0.707 in cut mode. The oversampling factor is chosen from the sample rate rather than being fixed; the README's "typically 4x" is not a constant in the code. ANALYSER_ENABLE_PARAM has no ParamWidget and cannot be clicked for help.
